request: Hai đầu mũi tên của mỗi trục tọa độ không được có vạch chia.

root_cause.generator: Empty tick list emitted as ytick={}, which requests automatic ticks from PGFPlots.
root_cause.shared_style: No guard against endpoint tick strokes.
root_cause.prior_gate: Matching embedded/source vectors did not check endpoint geometry.
root_cause.review: The agent missed the visible endpoint strokes during prior review; prior PASS is not acceptance of this defect.

implementation.empty_list: Emit \empty when no ticks are selected.
implementation.shared_style: Profile 0.4 guards tick stroke placement at the resolved min/max of each axis; labels are preserved independently.
implementation.graph_gate: Read actual PDF stroke paths and reject endpoint tick strokes before copying PDF/SVG outputs.
implementation.source_gate: Check every paired graph PDF, not just hashes.
implementation.print_gate: Require every source graph to pass endpoint checks and match its actual embedded vector stream.

files.regenerated: 35 G04 paired PDFs/SVGs through official generator; manifest dependencies and hashes written by the generator. Only S04c changes drawing content; other PDFs differ in generated metadata only. Old dated evidence not overwritten; new evidence directory under G04 ho_so/axis_end_ticks_20261019.

verification.visual: Reviewed corrected standalone figure and physical PDF page 57 (printed page 56), color and grayscale. Other 63 pages raster-identical to the previously reviewed candidate.
verification.prior_warning_retained: MiKTeX reports possible missing hyphen-vietnamese file; no replacement glyph or clipping in current checks.

limits.other_packages: Not rebuilt. Their recorded graph dependency hashes/cache may now be stale after the shared tool change; do not rewrite those hashes to claim current. Apply only after pilot review.
limits.html: Not rebuilt; existing HTML previews do not display this correction yet.
